system.flavor:
Hold a door shut against one person, wedge a gate so it jams when the next guard pulls it, pin a man in a narrow gap with a cart, or shove someone back out of a doorway he is trying to push through.

Not enough to bar a door against a crowd or to hold it all night.

body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within 2 units beside an obstacle or doorway.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, push the target 1 unit away from the obstacle and make it Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage on a hit.

rider.title: Contingency - Trap
rider.html: Mark one adjacent doorway or gap. When an enemy voluntarily crosses it, halt that movement after 1 unit; it may burn 1 die to continue.
